title: Edge Pathway Mini-Console: Upgrade Impact & Quick Actions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, contextual mini-console card for Private/VPC clusters that surfaces upgrade impact, recent network changes, and one-touch remediation actions. The card should live in the cluster overview and in tenant-level lists so operators can quickly assess risk and act without navigating into full cluster detail pages.
acceptance_criteria: Mini-console shows current software version and a compact upgrade risk score (0-100) computed from staged upgrades, tenant traffic, and recent failures.
Displays last 3 network events with timestamps and a colored severity indicator.
Includes two primary quick actions: 'Schedule Safe Upgrade' and 'Open Rapid Rollback' that trigger the existing rollout flow with prefilled context.
Has accessible color contrast, keyboard focus states, and tooltip explanations for each metric.
Instrumentation hooks added: click events for actions, impressions for the card, and error telemetry for failed action attempts.
Design handoff includes responsive specs for narrow list view and expanded hover state with additional diagnostics.
PM and Eng sign-off on risk score definition and backend telemetry schema before handoff.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Maya Chen: Initial concept sketch and problem statement posted. Aim to reduce context switching for on-call engineers.
2026-02-22 - Design critique: team prefers a numeric risk score over a 3-tier badge; request to validate with SRE team on thresholds.
2026-02-25 - Research update: analyzed 32 incidents where operators missed upgrade-related warnings; quick actions could have reduced MTTI in 40% of cases.
2026-02-28 - PM feedback (Aria): add cost preview when scheduling upgrades (estimated downtime cost) — kept as secondary row to avoid clutter.
2026-03-01 - Eng review (Noah): backend can expose a composite risk_score and last_network_events API; needs telemetry schema (ENG-24190) to land first.
2026-03-03 - Accessibility pass: color contrast and keyboard interactions updated; tooltip content simplified per A11y guidelines.
2026-03-04 - Liam O'Connor: Updated hi-fi screens uploaded; ready for implementation estimate and frontend pairing session.
Review notes: consider progressive disclosure for tenants with >50 clusters; show aggregated risk in list + per-cluster mini-console on hover.
implementation_notes: Frontend will implement a reusable MiniConsole component with props: clusterId, riskScore, events[], actions[]. Backend endpoints: /clusters/:id/mini_console and /clusters/:id/mini_console/actions. Telemetry events: mini_console.view, mini_console.action_click, mini_console.action_fail. Engineering to add feature flag for staged rollout.
ux_decisions: Use compact numeric risk score (0-100) with color gradient to preserve scan speed.
Limit events to 3 most recent network incidents to keep the card stable in height.
Primary action is contextual: if an upgrade is pending, show 'Schedule Safe Upgrade'; otherwise show 'Open Rapid Rollback'.
Secondary row reserved for a single-line cost estimate when relevant, collapsed by default.
Hover-expanded state reveals link to full diagnostics and an inline small sparkline for latency.
